profile.headline: Senior Web Developer, Lia Griffith Media, LLC
profile.summary:
WANTS TO BUILD AWESOME THINGS ON THE WEB.
My experience is mostly focused on frontend development and UX design, but I have a lot of experience working with backend systems, especially Node.js and PHP MVCs.

My secret weapon is my design experience: I was bred as a designer, but my career choices have forged me into a web developer. Being an artist and designer helps me appreciate the difficult UX and aesthetic choices that are a part of development, and gives me the knowledge to execute those decisions with technical solutions.

HE KNOWS THESE THINGS:

On the Frontend:
- Javascript
- HTML5 and CSS3
- How to make sure those two things play nice with all browsers
- Javascript Templating (especially Handlebar.js)
- Backbone.js (a Javascript framework for Model-View structures)
- A wee bit of Angular.js (which is just plain fun)

On the Backend:
- Node.js
- PHP (of course)
- Laravel (a PHP Framework)

Databases:
- MySQL
- PostGRES
- MongoDB

Content Management Systems:
- WordPress
- Drupal

WHY I DO
Web development is in an amazing phase right now. The industry has begun to embrace standardization and that stability has allowed the development community to create amazingly expressive code that has exponentially improved on user experiences. We in an era where web development can literally influence and inform every part of a person's life, and I am ecstatic to be a both a student and a participant in this flourishing frontier.

WHAT I WANT
Give me lunch money to do the stuff I talked about in the last bit.

educations.degreeName: Graphic Design with an emphasis on Web Design

projects.title: The Portland Tarot
projects.description: The Portland Tarot deck is a project that is currently under way, starring local personalities, landmarks, and concepts. I am creating the artwork for the deck through 2014. The style is surreal, a collection of digitally-collaged photographs capturing scenes both modern and arcane.

projects.title: Numerology.com
projects.description: Drupal-based web site. Completed design, Drupal setup, views configuration, context configuration, theme configuration, design slicing, and half of the CSS/HTML code.
